rules.name: RequestExAcceptJoinMPCC
rules.conversion: Preserve first serialized Top() argument; remove Interlude-only second dword. Exact lengths 7/11; other sizes rejected before encryption.

rules.name: RequestJoinPartyRoom

rules.name: RequestEnterWorldPacket
rules.conversion: Re-serialize original arguments with exact C4 format before encryption, retaining variable first blob and four dwords. Validate removed extension is exactly 88 bytes; no size-only wire slicing.

evidence: decompiled/outbound source and target exact methods; primary clientpackets references; native send hook tests
limits: RequestPledgePower still requires action/privilege semantic mapping. Unknown EnterWorld serializer formats remain unchanged. Caller/UI semantics require live validation; native serialization boundary tests do not prove all features.

validators.name: RequestPledgePower
validators.source_layout: cdd for actions 1/2; cddb with 32 raw bytes for other actions
validators.target_layout: cdd for action 1; cddd for action 2
validators.behavior: Reject lengths incompatible with the C4 action before native encryption/send. The 13-byte Interlude action-2 rank update is blocked, not translated.
validators.limitation: Does not establish rank/member equivalence or implement privilege modification. Nine-byte action-1 queries retain the existing route.
validators.evidence: test_native_pledge_requests.py executes both original sender functions up to the virtual send; tests verify emitted format, opcode, ID, action and raw buffer length.
